## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design observable, maintainable monitoring for SAP HANA on EC2 at beginner level.

## Key Concepts

- CloudWatch, CloudWatch Agent, SAP metrics, custom namespaces
- Dashboards and alarms, thresholding and evaluation periods
- Minimal IaC (CloudFormation) for alarms and alerting (SNS)

## Code Example

```yaml
Parameters:
  SAPInstanceId:
    Type: String
    Description: EC2 instance running SAP HANA
Resources:
  SAPAlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: SAPAlerts
  SAPLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: SAP_QueryLatency_High
      Namespace: SAP/HANA
      MetricName: QueryLatencyMs
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref SAPInstanceId
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 200
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SAPAlertsTopic
  SAPMemoryAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: SAP_MemoryUsage_High
      Namespace: SAP/HANA
      MetricName: MemoryUsagePct
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref SAPInstanceId
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SAPAlertsTopic
```

- How would you extend this with auto-remediation or on-call routing?
- What are potential costs and how would you optimize them?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to plan cross-account upgrade workflows with auditable controls, real-world DR validation, and automated rollback—vital for SAP on AWS where downtime and data integrity are critical.

## Key Concepts
- Cross-account IAM role trust and SCP boundaries
- Canary upgrades, automated validation (SAPControl, backups, DR)
- IaC for Roles and Step Functions skeleton
- Observability and safe rollback mechanisms

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal IaC: Trusting role for canary upgrades
Resources:
  CanaryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: "arn:aws:iam::<TEST_ACCOUNT_ID>:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CanaryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: "*"
```
```json
{
  "Comment": "Canary upgrade flow",
  "StartAt": "UpgradeCanary",
  "States": {
    "UpgradeCanary": {
      "Type": "Task",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:ssm:startAutomationExecution",
      "Next": "HealthCheck"
    },
    "HealthCheck": {
      "Type": "Choice",
      "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.status","StringEquals": "SUCCESS","Next": "BackupVerify"}],

      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:lambda:invoke",
      "Next": "End"
    },
    "End": {"Type": "Succeed"}

}
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question tests real-world DR design for SAP on AWS at scale, including cross-region replication, automated failover, and least-privilege controls. It probes integration points across SAP HANA, S3, IAM, and workflow services.

## Key Concepts
- SAP HANA System Replication (async vs sync) and log shipping
- Cross-region S3 backups with KMS-encrypted vaults
- IAM role design and SCPs for least privilege
- Step Functions with Lambda for automated DR workflow
- CloudFormation/IaC for DR artifacts

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation skeleton for DR roles and S3 backup configuration
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SAP HANA DR Roles and Infrastructure'

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Primary Region HANA to replicate data
  HANAReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sap-hana-dr-replication-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2RoleforSSM
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DRReplicationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::dr-backup-primary-bucket/*'

  # IAM Role for DR Region Lambda functions
  DRLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sap-dr-lambda-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DRWorkflowPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::dr-backup-primary-bucket'
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::dr-backup-primary-bucket/*'

  # S3 Cross-Region Backup Bucket
  DRBackupBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: dr-backup-primary-bucket
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyId: alias/sap-dr-backup-key
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ArchiveAfter30Days
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: ''
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 30
              - StorageClass: DEEP_ARCHIVE
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 365

    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: sap-dr-failover-workflow
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          {
            "Comment": "SAP HANA DR Failover State Machine",
            "StartAt": "CheckPrimaryHealth",
            "States": {
              "CheckPrimaryHealth": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:check-hana-health",
                "Next": "IsPrimaryHealthy",
                "TimeoutSeconds": 60
              },
              "IsPrimaryHealthy": {
                "Type": "Choice",
                "Choices": [
                  {
                    "Variable": "$.healthStatus",
                    "StringEquals": "healthy",
                    "Next": "WaitForRecovery"
                  }
                ],
                "Default": "InitiateFailover"
              },
              "WaitForRecovery": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 30,
                "Next": "CheckPrimaryHealth"
              },
              "InitiateFailover": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:initiate-hana-failover",
                "Next": "PromoteDRSite",
                "TimeoutSeconds": 300
              },
              "PromoteDRSite": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:promote-dr-site",
                "Next": "UpdateDNS",
                "TimeoutSeconds": 600
              },
              "UpdateDNS": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:update-route53-health",
                "Next": "VerifyApplication",
                "TimeoutSeconds": 120
              },
              "VerifyApplication": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:verify-app-connectivity",
                "End": true,
                "TimeoutSeconds": 180
              }
            }
          }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt DRLambdaRole.Arn

Outputs:
  ReplicationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the HANA replication role
    Value: !GetAtt HANAReplicationRole.Arn
  DRStateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the DR failover state machine
    Value: !GetAtt DRStateMachine.Arn
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical automation skills for SAP HANA backup reliability, emphasizing serverless event-driven verification, durable state management, and timely alerting mechanisms.

## Key Concepts
- S3 versioning with encrypted backup storage
- Lambda event-driven processing on S3 PUT operations
- Backup integrity verification using cryptographic checksums
- Durable result storage via DynamoDB
- Automated alerting through SNS or CloudWatch

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudocode: verify backup integrity
function verifyBackup(backupKey) {
  const actual = computeChecksum(backupData);
  const expected = getExpectedChecksum(backupKey);
  
  const result = {
    backupKey,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: actual === expected ? 'verified' : 'failed',
    actualChecksum: actual,
    expectedChecksum: expected
  };
  
  // Record in DynamoDB for durability
  dynamoDB.put(result);
  
  // Alert on failures
  if (result.status === 'failed') {
    sns.publish({
      message: `Backup integrity check failed for ${backupKey}`,
      subject: 'SAP HANA Backup Alert'
    });
  }
  
  return result;
}
```

## CloudFormation Example

```yaml
Resources:
  BackupVerificationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SAP-HANA-BackupVerificationRole

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::your-backup-bucket/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::your-backup-bucket
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccessPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem

        - PolicyName: SNSAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: arn:aws:sns:*:*:backup-alerts
```
